correctness.rationale: For odd characteristic the smooth quartic double cover is a degree-two del Pezzo; anticanonical smoothness is exactly simple branching on the rational line. The 31 lines have support counts 3,12,16; support-2 restrictions become diagonal with coefficient pair sums, and support-3 lines share the displayed discriminant. The complete 4-by-4 normalized discriminant matrix proves all 64 cases. Rational-point spectra follow from the fourth-power-one property and quadratic characters. Independent exact homogeneous-Sylvester and formula-based programs agree on all 64x31 cases and point counts.

value.rationale: The condition that every rational anticanonical genus-one curve is smooth is an extremal finite-field Bertini phenomenon on the complete anticanonical linear system. Diagonal quartics form a natural automorphism-rich family and F5 has the decisive arithmetic property (F5^×)^4={1}. The unique 12-coefficient all-transverse shape, dual-pointless property, and distinct point spectra of quadratic twists are not implied by the earlier fact that some F5 quartic is pointless or by Frobenius-Picard counts. Their exact incidence structure supplies a useful boundary example.
